욥기 9:2.content: I know it is so of a truth: but how should man be just with God?

욥기 9:3.content: If he will contend with him, he cannot answer him one of a thousand.

욥기 9:4.content: He is wise in heart, and mighty in strength: who hath hardened himself against him, and hath prospered?

욥기 9:5.content: Which removeth the mountains, and they know not: which overturneth them in his anger.

욥기 9:6.content: Which shaketh the earth out of her place, and the pillars thereof tremble.

욥기 9:7.content: Which commandeth the sun, and it riseth not; and sealeth up the stars.

욥기 9:8.content: Which alone spreadeth out the heavens, and treadeth upon the waves of the sea.

욥기 9:9.content: Which maketh Arcturus, Orion, and Pleiades, and the chambers of the south.

욥기 9:10.content: Which doeth great things past finding out; yea, and wonders without number.

욥기 9:11.content: Lo, he goeth by me, and I see him not: he passeth on also, but I perceive him not.

욥기 9:12.content: Behold, he taketh away, who can hinder him? who will say unto him, What doest thou?

욥기 9:13.content: If God will not withdraw his anger, the proud helpers do stoop under him.

욥기 9:14.content: How much less shall I answer him, and choose out my words to reason with him?

욥기 9:15.content: Whom, though I were righteous, yet would I not answer, but I would make supplication to my judge.

욥기 9:16.content: If I had called, and he had answered me; yet would I not believe that he had hearkened unto my voice.

욥기 9:17.content: For he breaketh me with a tempest, and multiplieth my wounds without cause.

욥기 9:18.content: He will not suffer me to take my breath, but filleth me with bitterness.

욥기 9:19.content: If I speak of strength, lo, he is strong: and if of judgment, who shall set me a time to plead?

욥기 9:20.content: If I justify myself, mine own mouth shall condemn me: if I say, I am perfect, it shall also prove me perverse.

욥기 9:21.content: Though I were perfect, yet would I not know my soul: I would despise my life.

욥기 9:22.content: This is one thing, therefore I said it, He destroyeth the perfect and the wicked.

욥기 9:23.content: If the scourge slay suddenly, he will laugh at the trial of the innocent.

욥기 9:24.content: The earth is given into the hand of the wicked: he covereth the faces of the judges thereof; if not, where, and who is he?

욥기 9:25.content: Now my days are swifter than a post: they flee away, they see no good.

욥기 9:26.content: They are passed away as the swift ships: as the eagle that hasteth to the prey.

욥기 9:27.content: If I say, I will forget my complaint, I will leave off my heaviness, and comfort myself:

욥기 9:28.content: I am afraid of all my sorrows, I know that thou wilt not hold me innocent.

욥기 9:29.content: If I be wicked, why then labour I in vain?

욥기 9:30.content: If I wash myself with snow water, and make my hands never so clean;

욥기 9:31.content: Yet shalt thou plunge me in the ditch, and mine own clothes shall abhor me.

욥기 9:32.content: For he is not a man, as I am, that I should answer him, and we should come together in judgment.

욥기 9:33.content: Neither is there any daysman betwixt us, that might lay his hand upon us both.

욥기 9:34.content: Let him take his rod away from me, and let not his fear terrify me:

욥기 9:35.content: Then would I speak, and not fear him; but it is not so with me.
